parts.title: Into the Library
parts.text: Hana, Dylan, and Esi walked into the library. It was **hushed**, so they used soft voices. Hana was a **bookworm** who read every day. “Let’s **browse** the shelves,” she whispered.

parts.title: A Cozy Nook
parts.text: Esi found a **nook** with a round rug and a big pillow. She opened a book with **marvelous** pictures of the sea. They were so wonderful that she gasped. Dylan read a **riddle** out loud. “What has hands but cannot clap?” he asked. “A clock!” said Hana.

parts.title: Story Time
parts.text: Then the librarian read a **tale** about a **brave** little mouse. The mouse went on a **quest** to find a lost key. The librarian’s squeaky mouse voice left the children **enchanted**, as if by magic. Esi was **captivated** and could not look away. Dylan was so **absorbed** that he forgot his snack.

parts.title: Time to Go
parts.text: The story ended, and everyone clapped. Each child picked a book to take home. “We will come back soon,” said Hana.
